items.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth faces House impeachment vote
items.feedTitle: Pete Hegseth faces House impeachment vote amid controversy over Iran War
items.summary: Rep. Thomas Massie (R-Ky.) forced a House vote to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, citing controversial policy decisions on Iran and Venezuela. Hegseth announced he will hold a news conference to defend his record. The effort faces long odds but signals GOP dissent over Hegseth's tenure as one of Trump's most controversial Cabinet picks.

items.title: Supreme Court allows Trump border wall construction in Texas
items.feedTitle: Supreme Court allows Big Bend border construction to continue in Texas, siding with Trump
items.summary: The Supreme Court halted a lower court's pause on barrier construction in Big Bend National Park, allowing the Trump administration to continue the project. The decision represents a major legal win for Trump's border security agenda despite environmental concerns.

items.title: Texas Democrat James Talarico sworn into Senate
items.feedTitle: Talarico, Cornyn meet in Washington
items.summary: Newly elected Sen. James Talarico (D-Texas) met with outgoing Sen. John Cornyn as lawmakers gathered for Capitol Hill orientation. Talarico, who defeated incumbent GOP Rep. Cory Mills in a primary, represents a significant Democratic gain in Texas.

items.title: Trump questions midterm election results without evidence
items.feedTitle: Trump Veers Back Into Claims of Rigged Election, Questioning Midterm Results
items.summary: President Trump returned to unfounded election fraud claims on Truth Social, questioning the integrity of the recent midterm results. The allegations contradicted his earlier acceptance of the outcome and drew criticism from Democratic leaders including Chuck Schumer.

items.title: Trump suggests deportation policy was too harsh for voters
items.feedTitle: Trump says his deportation policy 'might have been too tough' for midterm voters
items.summary: Trump told reporters his aggressive immigration enforcement approach may have cost Republicans in the midterms and expressed willingness to work with Democrats on an immigration deal. The comment represents a potential shift in his hard-line stance.

stlouis.title: St. Louis receives $68 million federal crime-fighting grant
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis to receive $68 million in federal funding to fight crime
stlouis.summary: Attorney General Todd Blanche announced that St. Louis won a Model Cities Initiative award, delivering $68 million in federal funding for law enforcement to tackle violent crime. The award highlights the region's status as a priority jurisdiction for federal support.

stlouis.title: St. Louis police launch drone transparency portal
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis police launch drone transparency portal
stlouis.summary: The St. Louis Police Department launched a new public portal to increase transparency around its drone operations. The initiative aims to provide accountability and public access to information about drone deployment and usage.

stlouis.title: Hospital discharge questioned after I-70 death
stlouis.feedTitle: Fiancee questions hospital discharge after O'Fallon man dies on I-70
stlouis.summary: The fiancée of an O'Fallon man who died on Interstate 70 is questioning the hospital's decision to discharge him, raising concerns about the discharge process and medical care decisions. The incident raises questions about patient safety and hospital protocols.

items.title: France blames Iran for supermarket refrigerator cyberattack
items.feedTitle: Iran was behind cyber-attack on French supermarket freezers, Paris says
items.summary: French authorities say a cyber unit linked to Iran's Revolutionary Guard hacked supermarket freezers and chillers across the country last month, spoiling food in over 1,000 stores. France's foreign minister called it an 'unprecedented scale' attack and vowed European sanctions against Tehran.

items.title: Russell Brand sentenced to 10.5 years in prison
items.feedTitle: Russell Brand sentenced to more than 10 years in prison for rape and sexual assault
items.summary: A UK jury convicted the comedian of raping one woman and sexually assaulting three others dating back to 2004. A judge praised victims' bravery and criticized Brand's 'casual, arrogant disregard' for women's consent. Jemima Goldsmith has separately accused him of physical assault and abuse.

items.title: Turkish steel plant explosion kills at least 16 people
items.feedTitle: Turkey steel factory blast kills at least 17 people
items.summary: An explosion at a blast furnace at the Habas Demir Celik plant near Izmir killed at least 16 workers after a crane collapsed into the furnace. President Erdogan announced an investigation; eyewitnesses reported the blast shook the ground violently.

items.title: Nvidia investigation shakes CEO over alleged Chinese spy affair
items.feedTitle: Nvidia shares slump amid investigation into CEO Jensen Huang
items.summary: Nvidia launched an independent investigation after reports that CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman allegedly working for Beijing intelligence. Huang admitted infidelity but denied compromising company security; Nvidia's shares fell sharply on the news.

items.title: Ukraine strikes Russia's second-largest oil refinery
items.feedTitle: Ukraine hits Russia’s second-largest refinery, Rosneft caps sales
items.summary: Ukrainian forces attacked Rosneft's Kirishi refinery, prompting the company to cap sales as fuel shortages return to Russian regions. The attack reflects Ukraine's ongoing targeting of Russian energy infrastructure to degrade military logistics.

items.title: Delhi air pollution hits worst level in five years
items.feedTitle: Delhi pollution on Diwali rockets to worst in 5 years
items.summary: Air quality in New Delhi deteriorated to 'severe' levels on Diwali after residents defied the firecracker ban, contributing to thick smog. Pollution monitoring data showed PM2.5 levels well above WHO guidelines as celebrations and seasonal factors worsened conditions.

items.title: PM Modi speaks with Zelenskyy on Ukraine peace efforts
items.feedTitle: PM Modi, Zelensky Discuss Bilateral Ties, Peace Efforts In Russia War
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy ahead of US-brokered Russia-Ukraine peace negotiations in Abu Dhabi. India offered to help establish a food corridor through the Black Sea to ease grain safety concerns.

items.title: Kiren Rijiju visits Saudi Arabia, signs Haj-2027 agreement; India’s pilgrim quota fixed at 1,75,025
items.feedTitle: Kiren Rijiju visits Saudi Arabia, signs Haj-2027 agreement; India’s pilgrim quota fixed at 1,75,025
items.summary: Summary unavailable for this update.

items.title: Chinese vloggers falsely portray Dhaka slums as Delhi
items.feedTitle: Chinese whispers in Dhaka: 1000s of vloggers film suburb, claim they’re in ‘dirty’ India. No one knows why
items.summary: Thousands of Chinese vloggers have livestreamed from poor neighborhoods in Dhaka, Bangladesh, falsely claiming they were in Delhi to paint India negatively. A JNU professor accused the effort of seeking to damage India's reputation through coordinated misinformation.

items.title: Punjab records biggest single-day spike in farm fires
items.feedTitle: 1,152 farm fires on Diwali day reverse Punjab’s stubble-burning progress
items.summary: Punjab reported 1,152 farm fires on Diwali, the season's largest single-day jump, reversing progress on stubble-burning reduction. The spike contributed to severe air pollution across northern India and renewed political accusations between ruling and opposition parties.

immigration.title: DHS ends automatic work permit extensions, finalized and in effect
immigration.feedTitle: Removal of Automatic Extensions for Certain Employment Authorization Documents
immigration.summary: The Trump administration published an interim final rule on October 30, 2025, ending the automatic extension of employment authorization documents (Forms I-766, or EADs) for applicants with timely renewal filings. This policy change, now in effect, requires workers to apply affirmatively to renew rather than relying on automatic extensions of up to 540 days.

immigration.title: Stephen Miller promoted to White House Chief of Staff
immigration.feedTitle: Stephen Miller Becomes White House Chief of Staff: What It Means for Legal Immigrants
immigration.summary: Trump promoted hard-line immigration adviser Stephen Miller to Chief of Staff, replacing Susie Wiles. The move signals intensified focus on restrictive immigration policies and raises concerns among legal immigrant advocates about enforcement direction.

immigration.title: US plans largest mass visa revocation in history targeting 200,000
immigration.feedTitle: US set for largest mass visa revocation in history targeting up to 200,000 foreigners, officials say
immigration.summary: US officials say the government is preparing for the largest visa revocation in history, potentially targeting up to 200,000 foreign nationals who have violated their visa status. The proposed action represents a major escalation in immigration enforcement scope.

items.title: Dow rallies 1,000 points, Nasdaq gains 2.5% on oil slide
items.feedTitle: Stock Market Today, Nov. 9, 2026: Nvidia Slides Amid Alleged Chinese Spying as Dow Surges Over 1,000 Points
items.summary: US stock markets surged Monday with the Dow jumping over 1,000 points and Nasdaq up 2.5% after oil prices fell to $97 amid speculation about potential Iran peace talks. The rally clawed back some of last week's tech losses, though Nvidia fell 6.5% amid the Chinese spy investigation.

items.title: ICE to Launch Wind Futures in Expansion of Global Energy Markets
items.feedTitle: ICE to Launch Wind Futures in Expansion of Global Energy Markets
items.summary: Summary unavailable for this update.

items.title: Nifty 50 reclaims 25,000 as PSU banks rally on crude decline
items.feedTitle: Sensex gains 107 points, Nifty reclaims 25,000 amid easing oil prices & buying in bank stocks
items.summary: Indian benchmark Nifty 50 gained 8.58% to close above 25,000 levels, with PSU bank stocks surging 3.7% as crude oil prices declined and foreign investor inflows strengthened. The index hit an 8-month high despite IT stocks dragging on global AI concerns.

items.title: Boeing to cut 5% of commercial airplane workforce
items.feedTitle: Boeing to cut about 5% of its commercial plane workforce
items.summary: Boeing announced it will reduce approximately 5% of its commercial airplane workers through layoffs and attrition as the company moderates the pace of ramping up jet production. The company will begin issuing notices in December.

items.title: Honda to invest $3 billion in new Ohio vehicle plant
items.feedTitle: Honda to invest $3 billion in new vehicle assembly plant in Ohio
items.summary: Honda announced a $3 billion investment to build a new vehicle assembly plant in central Ohio focused on hybrid vehicle production. The move expands Honda's US manufacturing footprint and green energy commitments.

India's Nifty reclaimed 25,000 on foreign inflows and PSU strength. cards.title: What lies within your control
cards.insight: A stoic recognizes that outcomes—whether elections, market movements, or others' judgments—often escape our grasp. Only your effort, choices, and responses remain under your command. Fixating on what you cannot change drains energy from what you can shape.
cards.takeaway: Today, identify one uncontrollable worry and redirect mental energy toward a decision or action within your power.

cards.title: Indifference to fortune's turns
cards.insight: Wealth, status, and technological dominance are 'preferred indifferents'—useful but not the source of a well-lived life. A CEO embroiled in scandal and a worker facing layoffs both benefit from accepting circumstance and maintaining their character intact.
cards.takeaway: Before reacting to news—good or bad—ask: does this change who I choose to be, or only what I temporarily possess?

cards.title: The discipline of assent
cards.insight: Events happen. Your job is not to prevent them, but to choose your judgment about them. A natural disaster, a betrayal, a policy shift—none require your emotional turbulence unless you assent to the narrative that you are harmed.
cards.takeaway: When facing setback, pause and separate fact from the story you're telling yourself about it.

cards.title: Virtue as the only true good
cards.insight: In times of flux—political upheaval, corporate scandal, mass layoffs—stoicism anchors you to what cannot be taken: integrity, wisdom, courage, and justice. These outlast any headline.
cards.takeaway: Ask yourself: in this situation, what virtue am I being called to practice, regardless of the outcome?

ai.title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable, Mythos models ahead of IPO
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns
ai.summary: Anthropic unveiled new frontier AI models—Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos—with improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision capabilities, priced 20% below OpenAI's competitive offerings. The launch comes days before Anthropic's highly anticipated IPO, positioning the company as a strong challenger to OpenAI.

ai.title: Nvidia CEO Huang's affair threatens China market access
ai.feedTitle: Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy puts Nvidia’s China ambitions under scrutiny
ai.summary: Jensen Huang's alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy threatens to complicate Nvidia's lobbying efforts to loosen US chip export restrictions and maintain access to China's AI market. The scandal coincides with heightened national security scrutiny of US-China technology ties.

ai.title: Meta launches Muse Ember, lightweight agent model at $0.10 per million tokens
ai.feedTitle: Meta launches Muse Ember, a small AI model built for the repetitive work agents actually do
ai.summary: Meta released Muse Ember, its cheapest AI agent model priced at $0.10 per million input tokens, designed for repetitive task execution. The model undercuts frontier competitors significantly and reflects Meta's push into affordable, specialized AI for practical applications.

ai.title: Google challenges Nvidia with new AI chips for privacy
ai.feedTitle: Google Takes Aim at Nvidia With New AI Chips Built for Privacy and Massive Memory
ai.summary: Google unveiled new custom AI chips designed to handle privacy-sensitive workloads and massive memory requirements, competing directly with Nvidia's AI chip dominance. The move signals Google's strategic effort to reduce dependency on Nvidia and advance its own silicon capabilities.

ai.title: AI spending stalls as price cuts, cost controls kick in
ai.feedTitle: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
ai.summary: Ramp data shows AI spending has plateaued despite rising usage, driven by price cuts from major providers and smarter cost controls among large spenders. The trend challenges investor assumptions about explosive AI hypergrowth and comes as Anthropic approaches its IPO.
